pattern: に過ぎない（にすぎない）
purpose: Limit the significance or extent of something.
keywords: Plain clause / N + に過ぎない
The investigation has only just begun.
Participants accounted for only one tenth of the total.
formation: Plain clause / N + に過ぎない
restrictions: Often means no more than, only, or merely.
mistake: The limitation is the speaker’s framing and may understate significance.
